result.title: OntoInk: Interactive Ontology Visualization, Validation, and Reasoning
result.comment: Demo paper at ISWC 2026 Companion Volume, October 25 to 29, 2026, Bari, Italy
result.summary: Ontology documentation, visualization, and validation are usually carried out with separate tools. This split workflow slows down development and makes knowledge transfer harder. We present OntoInk, an open-source MkDocs plugin that brings these activities together. Within a single documentation-as-code pipeline, OntoInk renders interactive ontology diagrams, validates instance data against SHACL shapes, runs OWL\,DL reasoning, and supports inline Turtle editing. General-purpose diagram plugins for MkDocs cannot parse RDF, dereference IRIs, overlay SHACL constraints, or run OWL reasoning. Compared with standalone ontology visualization tools, OntoInk embeds interactive and editable diagrams directly into documentation pages. A live demo and source code are available at \url{https://ise-fizkarlsruhe.github.io/ontoink/}.

AI.brief_summary: OntoInk 是一个开源 MkDocs 插件，将本体文档、交互式可视化、SHACL 校验与 OWL DL 推理整合进文档即代码流水线。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作面向本体文档化与校验工具链，不涉及 VLM 推理的状态生成、视觉证据使用或推理决策，未见可供 LVR 借鉴的具体线索。
